Yuki: run quick dedupe locally:
```bash
python tools/dedupe_check.py --bank /data/promptbank --sample /internal/curation/tmp/qbring_fails.csv --sim 0.87
```
That prints candidate collisions + anchor ids.

Rahul: i'll try kv_norm=true and headroom=0.12 tonight and post a tiny perf/quality table (profile, F1, hallucination-heuristic, latency-delta).

deploy-bot: snapshot saved: qbring-20241010-snap1. Traffic set to 0% pending triage.
